name: critic-calibrate
context_rationale: Analytical maintenance pass — all inputs are on disk (archived reflections, agents/critique.md, the calibration log) and the heavy analysis runs in a fresh-context 'critic-calibrate' subagent; nothing depends on the main thread's current slice state (requires_full_context: false). Classified delegable like its interactive peers (commit-slice, drift-check, supersede-slice, slice-candidates); it STAYS INLINE at runtime only because of the per-proposal AskUserQuestion review gates (Step 3) — a forked subagent cannot run AskUserQuestion (the fork caveat), so it gets no context:fork.
summary: Cross-slice meta-skill that calibrates the Critic in BOTH directions. ADD: mines 'Missed by Critic' + 'Critic calibration' entries from the last N (default 15) archived reflections (>=3-distinct-slices threshold) for 0-3 evidence-backed prompt-addition proposals. LIGHTEN (Phase 4.1 / Theme 5): mines the gate-log precision/quiet-rate + reflection FALSE-ALARM data for 0-2 proposals to lighten a low-value model-on-model gate/dimension (a calibration_notes[] entry /critique + /code-review read) or retire a noisy project active_check — the reality spine (risk-spike/validate-slice) is NEVER lightened. Spawns a 'critic-calibrate' subagent; proposals are presented one-at-a-time for accept/modify/reject; this skill never auto-applies edits to the plugin's Critic prompt. Logs every run to critic-calibration-log.json (@3) for longitudinal effectiveness tracking.

reads.purpose: Enumerate last N archived slice folders for reflection window
Extract Critic calibration + Missed by Critic sections for pattern analysis
Optional quick navigation to archived slices
Read active_checks[] + calibration_notes[] (dedup new ADD/LIGHTEN proposals against the live overlay) and runs[] (effectiveness pass) before proposing

Read recent rows for the model-on-model gates (critique/critique-review/code-review) to compute precision + quiet-rate — the LIGHTEN signal (Phase 4.1). The reality gates (risk-spike/validate-slice) are excluded by the skill's filter and are never lighten candidates.

outputs.purpose: Append the run to runs[]; upsert accepted ADD proposals into active_checks[] and confirmed LIGHTEN proposals into calibration_notes[] (or retire a noisy active_check) — the deduped project overlay /critique + /code-review read. NEVER edits the plugin's agents/critique.md.

agents.name: critic-calibrate
agents.when: Step 2, after gathering archived reflections, current Critic prompt, and calibration log
agents.purpose: Classifies Critic miss patterns, applies evidence threshold, and generates 0-3 targeted prompt-update proposals for critique.md

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read archived reflection.json files (Critic calibration sections), the plugin's agents/critique.md, critic-calibration-log.json

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Present each proposal one-at-a-time for user accept/modify/reject decision
